summary: List payments subtiers for the requisition

items.description: A subtier as returned in the context of a requisition (invoice), including its per-requisition billing details.

commitment_id.description: Identifier of the project commitment (contract) this subtier is tracked under.

commitment_amount.description: Total contracted amount committed to this subtier.

amount_billed_to_date.description: Cumulative amount billed to date for this subtier on the current requisition.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the subtier. One of active, exempt, lien_filed, final_expected, or final_received.

waiver_contact_email.description: Email address of the subtier contact who receives lien waivers to e-sign.

subtier_type.description: Whether the subtier is a supplier or a subcontractor.

kind_of_work.description: Description of the type of work the subtier performs.

state_code.description: State or province code of the subtier's address.

zip.description: Postal/ZIP code of the subtier's address.

country_code.description: Country code of the subtier's address.

additional_address_information.description: Supplementary address details such as suite or unit number.

hired_by_subtier_id.description: Identifier of the subtier that hired this subtier, establishing the hiring hierarchy. Null when hired directly by the commitment holder.

hired_by_subtier_name.description: Company name of the subtier that hired this subtier.

joint_check_future_requisitions.description: Whether future requisitions for this subtier should be paid by joint check.

vendor_id.description: Identifier of the vendor record associated with this subtier. Null when no vendor is linked.

vendor_verified.description: Whether the associated vendor has been verified for payments.

beneficiary_status.description: Procore Pay beneficiary status of the associated vendor.

subtier_requisitions.description: Per-requisition billing details for this subtier. Only returned when extended=true.

items.description: Billing details for the subtier on a single requisition.
